name: Fixed monthly allowance
authority: CPF Act 1953 s.2(1) and First Schedule: a fixed allowance payable for the month is an Ordinary Wage. Part month: Employment Act s.20A — the monthly gross rate (fixed allowances included) × days worked ÷ days required to work. A required day of 5 hours or less counts as half a day when the month is incomplete (s.20A(2)), as for BASIC. EA s.20A (MOM, Monthly and daily salary: definitions and calculation, https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/monthly-and-daily-salary, updated 8 Dec 2025, read 2026-10-08: incomplete month = monthly gross ÷ the month’s working days, public holidays included, × days worked). A complete month pays the monthly amount ÷ period.parts in each part (a semi-monthly half pays exactly half). An incomplete month (start after the 1st, exit before the last day, or a part not wholly employed) pays the monthly amount × days worked ÷ (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days); the last part of a month the employment started before settles the month: the s.20A total (the earlier parts’ working days, this part’s worked) less what the month’s earlier slips paid for the code (earned.month), so a leaver recorded after the first half was paid is exact. A ≤ 5-hour required day counts as half in an incomplete month. No-pay and unauthorised days deduct through their own lines at the same divisor. With nothing planned, paid days ÷ the month’s calendar days.

name: Contractual annual leave hourly addition (OW)
authority: MOM Part-time employment: leave (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/part-time-employment/leave), retrieved 2026-10-03: clear contractual annual-leave encash agreement, prohibited where work is at least five days and 30–34 hours weekly; hourly addition is annual leave hours divided by weekly hours times 52, multiplied by original hourly gross pay. CPF Board https://ask.gov.sg/cpf/questions/cm0f52l39035vpz7a3bwg3pre: OW must be wholly and exclusively for one calendar month and payable by the 14th of the following month. Explicit OW/AW class admission uses the actual signed payable clause; payment date is not payable date. Source-year quantity remains conserved against actual computed and consumed/reserved hourly entitlement. A sub-monthly entity pays the month’s amount in its parts: each settlement period prices allowance.amount ÷ period.parts before proration (a semi-monthly half pays half the monthly allowance).
